excerpts: Our trash provider is Waste Connections.

Make sure to place bins outside by 7 am for trash collection. For Providence Village, trash is picked up weekly on Monday, and recycling is picked up every other Monday. For Ascent Village, trash is picked up weekly on Tuesday, and recycling is picked up every other Tuesday. For Prospect Village, trash is picked up weekly on Thursday, and recycling is picked up every other Thursday.
Trash pickup will be delayed by one day for the following holidays: New Year's Day Memorial Day Independence Day Labor Day Thanksgiving Christmas.

Waste Connections also has an emergency phone call system that can notify residents in case of a delay or interruption in service. Service Notification Form ... Download the WasteConnect app to view your pickup schedule, set up reminders, contact customer service, and more.
